decision.rationale: Attempt 002 is operationally invalid. The same Mistral reviewer path has now terminated both bounded calibration attempts before a vote was accepted, so the reviewer method must be redesigned instead of retried.
limitations: The sanitized provider response identifies HTTP 400 but intentionally omits unrestricted provider text.
Reported USD 0 is unavailable provider accounting rather than verified zero spend.
No Mistral or DeepSeek calibration metric and no 200-case confirmation metric is available.
LLM calibration would remain silver evidence even after a valid successor run.
